description: This file is a shell script for resolving merge conflicts in Git. It provides functions for handling symlinks, submodules, file descriptions, and different conflict resolution strategies, integrating with Git commands to facilitate merge conflict resolution and user interaction.

methods.name: is_symlink
methods.description: Checks if the given file mode indicates a symbolic link.

methods.name: is_submodule
methods.description: Checks if the given file mode indicates a submodule.

methods.name: local_present
methods.description: Checks if the local file mode is set.

methods.name: remote_present
methods.description: Checks if the remote file mode is set.

methods.name: base_present
methods.description: Checks if the base file mode is set.

methods.name: mergetool_tmpdir_init
methods.description: Initializes a temporary directory for merge tools.

methods.name: cleanup_temp_files
methods.description: Removes temporary files created during merge resolution.

methods.name: describe_file
methods.description: Prints a description of the file based on its mode and branch.

methods.name: resolve_symlink_merge
methods.description: Handles merging conflicts involving symbolic links.

methods.name: resolve_deleted_merge
methods.description: Handles merging conflicts where a file was deleted.

methods.name: stage_submodule
methods.description: Stages a submodule during merge conflict resolution.

methods.name: checkout_staged_file
methods.description: Checks out a file from the index at a specific stage.

methods.name: hide_resolved
methods.description: Prepares files to hide conflicts through a merge file.

methods.name: merge_file
methods.description: Main function for handling file merge conflicts using the configured merge tool.

methods.name: prompt_after_failed_merge
methods.description: Asks user whether to continue after a failed merge.

methods.name: print_noop_and_exit
methods.description: Prints a message indicating no files need merging and exits.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the script, orchestrates the merge conflict resolution process.
